title: Office Nature asserts global growth targets in organic personal care
summary: Born from the merger of Laboratoire Science et Nature and Nature et Stratégie, two pioneering French players in natural & organic cosmetics and household cleaning products, Office Nature aims to speed up its global expansion and reach EUR 90 million in revenue by 2030. Olivier Guilbaud, co-Manager, told us more about its strategy.
